title: 第二十八章 宿命抉择生死与共第二十七章 羁绊为刃全员合击
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 天光彻底破开万古阴霾，暖融融的圣光铺满整片残破重生的空域。
绵延万年笼罩天地的暗黑天幕彻底消散无踪，澄澈干净的湛蓝天色一览无余，细碎温柔的金色阳光穿透层层舒展的云层，温柔洒落，轻轻覆过满目疮痍的战场，覆过六道并肩伫立、身姿挺拔的少年少女身影。
历经一场倾尽全员本源、熔铸生死羁绊的终极合击，肆虐星界万载的暗蚀本源被彻底击溃，盘踞天地万古的暗黑霸权轰然崩塌。漫天游荡、残存许久的暗黑戾气、细碎黑雾，在持续不绝的圣光净化之下，消融殆尽、荡然无存。
天地间压抑了万年的阴沉死寂彻底褪去，取而代之的是万物复苏、澄澈安宁的鲜活气息。
琉光星冕综合学园震颤不止的大地渐渐平稳，此前因剧烈灵力冲撞、空间崩裂产生的地面裂痕缓缓愈合，被战火灼烧、暗黑腐蚀的草木土壤，在天光与残存圣光的滋养下，悄然抽芽复绿，一点点抚平战争留下的所有疮痍。
空域之中，六芒星终极法阵的光芒彻底敛入虚空，幻时交错双重领域尽数消散，被冻结、阻滞许久的时空彻底恢复正常流转。风息重新温柔吹拂，天光重新肆意流淌，世间一切，都在朝着最安稳明媚的方向缓缓归序。
六位天启守护者并肩伫立在空域中央，刚刚卸下终极合击的磅礴力量，周身灵力尚且处于剧烈透支后的震荡与疲软之中。
持续数时辰的高强度控场、极限鏖战、本源透支、终极爆发，早已将六人肉身经脉、神魂心力压榨至极致临界点。每个人的气息都略显虚浮绵长，呼吸轻重错落，带着难以掩饰的疲惫与倦怠，周身萦绕的圣光辉色也褪去了战时的璀璨凌厉，变得温润黯淡、单薄无力。
可即便身心俱疲、灵力耗竭，六人依旧身姿挺拔、脊背笔直，彼此间距咫尺相依，无需言语，无需对视，并肩而立的姿态，便是历经生死淬炼后，最坚定不渝的羁绊印证。
天野凛星静静站在队伍最中央，作为整场终局之战的绝对核心、承载全员羁绊与力量的枢纽，他的损耗远比其余五人更为剧烈。
一身二段觉醒传说形态的圣光凛霜天启圣衣，此刻敛去了君临天地的磅礴威严，霜白、耀金、暖黄交织的渐变圣纹黯淡无光，衣身各处布满细密的灵力裂痕，那是强行容纳六大本源同源爆发、承受极致力量反噬留下的痕迹。
他那头霜白晕染耀金的渐变长发微微垂落，褪去了战时高束的凌厉利落，几缕碎发黏在微凉汗湿的额角，少了几分王者的肃穆威严，多了几分极致透支后的孱弱疲惫。
原本澄澈锐利、覆着冰封寒芒的冰蓝色眼眸，此刻微微敛着光泽，眼底沉淀着厚重的倦意，长长的眼睫轻轻垂落，遮住了眸底翻涌的灵力酸胀与心神耗竭。周身萦绕的天启圣光微弱飘忽，不再具备碾压黑暗、审判万邪的磅礴威势，只剩浅浅一层护住肉身的微薄灵力屏障。
刚刚彻底终结万古暗黑浩劫的释然与安稳，缓缓漫过他的心神，压过了连日鏖战的紧绷与凌厉。他微微松了松紧绷许久的肩背，修长有力的手指缓缓松开紧握许久的圣光宝剑。
通体澄澈、流转六色本源微光的圣剑轻轻悬浮在他身侧，剑体流光内敛、光华黯淡，静静随着主人的气息微微浮动，极致爆发过后，神兵亦随之陷入短暂的灵力休憩状态。
他缓缓抬眸，目光温柔而笃定，一一扫过身旁并肩作战、不离不弃的五位同伴，沉稳温和的嗓音穿透周遭细碎的灵力余息，清晰响起。
“结束了。”
简单三个字，落得轻柔，却承载了数年浴血厮杀、万载黑暗对抗的所有重量，落进每一个人的心底，抚平了长久以来紧绷的惶恐与负重。
“万年暗蚀祸乱，全域暗影军团，暗樱女王的暗黑统治，今日尽数终结。从今往后，世间再无万古黑暗，再无暗蚀浩劫。”
话音落，他唇角缓缓扬起一抹浅淡温润的笑意，眼底所有的凝重、戒备、沉重尽数散去，只剩尘埃落定的释然与守护山河的赤诚。
藤咲若织站在他身侧，鎏红绛赤渐变的二段翠炎万华圣临圣衣静静贴合身姿，华贵繁复的红莲草木圣纹黯淡收敛，不再流转焚尽万邪的炽烈火光。
她周身蓬勃相生的草火双生本源已然趋于平缓，此前极致爆发、凝出圣草银金凤凰极致奥义的经脉依旧隐隐酸胀，细密的汗珠浸透了额前的碎发，衬得那张温婉清丽的面容愈发苍白孱弱。
可她的眼神依旧澄澈温柔、明亮坚定，鎏光红调的长卷发随微风轻轻拂动，褪去了战时的凌厉锋芒，回归了本该有的温婉安然。
听闻天野凛星的话语，她轻轻抬眸望向身旁的少年，眼底盛满了历经风雨终见光明的柔软笑意，清甜温软的嗓音轻轻附和：
“是啊，终于结束了。”
三年隐匿蛰伏，三年并肩同行，从孤身流落人间、隐姓埋名的王族遗孤，到遇见并肩相守的同伴，从一次次绝境厮杀、一次次彼此救赎，到今日亲手终结绵延万古的黑暗浩劫。
那些深埋心底的隐忍、孤勇、疲惫与执念，那些浴血奋战的伤痛、绝境重生的坚韧，在这一刻尽数化作安稳的释然。
她侧首看向不远处气息虚脱、身形微晃的夜见幽弥，眼底漾开浓浓的心疼与暖意，脚步轻挪，稳稳搀扶住少女纤细的手臂，温柔的力道稳稳托住对方透支过重的身躯。
“幽弥，辛苦你了。整场战局，是你从头到尾稳住幻境禁锢，锁死暗樱女王的意识与执念，从未有过半分松懈。”
夜见幽弥周身冥紫鎏堇的二段冥幻星影轮回圣衣光影淡薄，流转的幻影圣纹彻底黯淡，极致透支的神魂让她整个人都透着一股疏离的虚弱感。
长达数时辰不间断维系高阶双重幻境、精神禁锢对手神魂、承受极致精神力损耗与反噬，再叠加终极合击的本源爆发，早已让她的肉身与神魂双双抵达崩溃的边缘。
往日里清冷孤傲、覆着一层薄冰的眼眸此刻水光微淡，褪去了所有疏离冷冽与戒备锋芒，只剩极致疲惫后的柔软松弛。被藤咲若织温热的指尖扶住手臂的瞬间，她紧绷到极致的心神彻底松懈下来，浑身紧绷的力道骤然散去，身形下意识微微倚靠向身旁的挚友。
清冷沙哑的嗓音带着一丝难以掩饰的倦怠，轻轻响起：
“我只是做了该做的事。”
简单淡漠的回应，却藏着她一路走来所有的孤勇与坚守。
从挣脱黑暗桎梏、摆脱傀儡宿命，到放下过往爱恨执念，真心归属于这支并肩相守的战队，对她而言，守护同伴、守护这片来之不易的光明，早已是胜过一切的执念与信仰。
只要能够终结黑暗、护住身边之人，再多的损耗、再重的疲惫，都值得。
御神苍静立在阵型后侧，霆苍鎏冰渐变的二段时序霆光神域圣衣清冷肃穆，此刻也敛尽了雷霆审判、时序禁锢的凛冽威势。
衣身纵横交错的时序纹路、雷霆圣纹尽数黯淡，不再流转冻结时空、劈碎虚妄的蓝白光流，周身萦绕的时电双生本源趋于平缓，却依旧维持着最细微的感知力，未曾彻底放松警惕。
她墨色澄澈的眼眸依旧沉静如水，清冷的目光遥遥落在空域中央，那道悬浮半空、大势已去、彻底落败的纤细身影之上。
全程定格时空、封禁空域、掌控战局节奏、稳住六芒星法阵时序，长时间双本源超负荷运转，让她清冷的眉眼间覆着一层浓重的疲惫，柔顺垂落的蓝调长发微微凌乱，不复往日的规整静谧。
可她的语气依旧沉稳冷静、条理清晰，带着对战局最精准透彻的判断，字字笃定、毫无疏漏：
“暗樱女王本源核心彻底碎裂，暗黑神魂濒临溃散，与全域暗影网络的连接永久断裂，所有黑暗力量尽数清零。”
“她如今肉身孱弱、神魂破败、灵力尽失，已然彻底沦为普通人之躯，没有任何再战之力，更没有任何调动黑暗、掀起祸乱的可能。”
content_en:
The skylight completely broke through the eternal haze, and the warm holy light filled the entire airspace that was broken and reborn.
The dark sky that had shrouded the world for tens of thousands of years completely dissipated, and the clear and clean blue sky was unobstructed. The fine and gentle golden sunlight penetrated through the layers of stretched clouds, gently falling down, gently covering the devastated battlefield, and covering the six figures of young girls standing side by side with tall and straight postures.
After a final attack that exhausted all the members' origins and forged the bond of life and death, the source of darkness that had been ravaging the star world for thousands of years was completely defeated, and the dark hegemony that had dominated the world for eternity collapsed. The dark malevolence and fine black mist that had been wandering in the sky for a long time were completely dissolved and disappeared under the continuous purification of holy light.
The gloomy and dead silence between heaven and earth that had been suppressed for thousands of years completely faded away, replaced by the fresh breath of resurrection, clarity and tranquility of all things.
The trembling ground of the Glazed Star Crown Comprehensive Academy gradually stabilized. The cracks on the ground caused by the violent collision of spiritual energy and the collapse of space slowly healed. The vegetation and soil that had been burned by the war and corroded by darkness quietly sprouted and turned green under the nourishment of the skylight and the remaining holy light, gradually healing all the scars left by the war.
In the airspace, the light of the six-pointed star's ultimate array completely converged into the void, the intertwined dual realms of illusion and time completely dissipated, and the time and space that had been frozen and blocked for a long time completely returned to normal flow. The wind blows gently again, the skylight flows freely again, and everything in the world is slowly returning to the most stable and bright direction.
The six guardians of the Apocalypse stood side by side in the center of the airspace. They had just unloaded the majestic power of the ultimate attack, and their spiritual energy was still in the state of shock and weakness after a severe overdraft.
Several hours of high-intensity field control, extreme fierce battles, source overdraft, and ultimate explosion had already squeezed the physical meridians, souls, and minds of the six people to the extreme critical point. Everyone's breath seemed a little hollow and long, and their breathing was light and heavy, with hard-to-conceal fatigue and lethargy. The color of the holy light lingering around them had also faded from the bright and sharp colors during the war, and became warm, dim, thin and weak.
But even though they were exhausted physically and mentally, and their spiritual energy was exhausted, the six of them still stood tall and straight, with their backs straight and close to each other. There was no need to speak or look at each other. The posture of standing side by side was the most unwavering proof of the bond that had been tempered by life and death.
Amano Rinsei stood quietly at the center of the team. As the absolute core of the entire final battle and the hub that carries the bonds and strength of all members, his loss was far more severe than that of the other five.
The Holy Light Frost Apocalypse Holy Cloth in the legendary form of the second stage of awakening has now lost the majestic majesty of the king of heaven and earth. The gradient holy patterns of frost white, shining gold, and warm yellow are dim and dull. The body of the clothes is covered with fine spiritual cracks, which are the traces left by forcibly accommodating the explosion of the six origins and enduring the extreme power backlash.
His long, frosty white hair that tinged with gold fell slightly, losing the neatness of the high bun during the war. A few strands of broken hair stuck to his cool, sweaty forehead, which was a little less solemn and majestic as a king, and a little more frail and exhausted after extreme overdraft.
The ice-blue eyes that were originally clear and sharp, covered with ice-cold light, were now slightly glossy, with heavy tiredness settling in them. The long eyelashes gently drooped, covering the surging spiritual energy and mental exhaustion under the eyes. The Holy Light of Apocalypse lingering around him was weak and erratic, no longer possessing the majestic power to crush the darkness and judge all evils, leaving only a thin spiritual barrier to protect his body.
The relief and peace that had just ended the eternal dark catastrophe slowly filled his mind, overpowering the tension and fierceness of the fierce battle for days. He slightly relaxed his shoulders that had been tense for a long time, and his long and strong fingers slowly released the Holy Light Sword that he had held tightly for a long time.
The holy sword, which was completely clear and filled with six-color original shimmer, gently floated beside him. The sword's flow was restrained and its brilliance was dim. It quietly floated slightly with the master's breath. After the ultimate explosion, the divine weapon also fell into a short-term spiritual rest state.
He slowly raised his eyes, his eyes gentle and determined, scanning the five companions who were fighting side by side and never leaving. His calm and gentle voice penetrated the residual spiritual energy around him and sounded clearly.
"It's over."
These three simple words fell softly, but they carried all the weight of years of bloody fighting and ten thousand years of dark confrontation. They fell into everyone's heart and relieved the long-standing fear and burden.
"The Ten Thousand Years of Darkness, the Shadow Legion, and the Dark Sakura Queen's dark rule all end today. From now on, there will be no more eternal darkness and no more Darkness catastrophe in the world."
As he finished speaking, a faint and gentle smile slowly appeared on his lips, and all the solemnity, wariness, and heaviness in his eyes disappeared, leaving only the settled relief and the sincerity to protect the mountains and rivers.
Fujisaki Wakaori stood beside him, the two-section emerald flame Wanhua Saint Cloth with gradual changes from gilded crimson to crimson quietly fit his figure. The luxurious and complicated sacred patterns of red lotus, grass and trees dimmed and converged, and no longer circulated the blazing fire that burned away all evil.
The vigorous twin origins of grass and fire all over her body have tended to calm down. The meridians that had previously exploded and condensed the ultimate mysteries of the sacred grass, silver, gold and phoenix were still faintly sore and swollen. Fine beads of sweat soaked into the broken hair on her forehead, making her gentle and beautiful face look increasingly pale and weak.
But her eyes were still clear, gentle, bright and firm, and her long gilded red curly hair was gently blowing in the breeze, losing the sharp edge during the war and returning to the gentle and peaceful nature she should have had.
After hearing Amano Rinsei's words, she gently raised her eyes to look at the boy beside her. Her eyes were filled with a soft smile that finally saw the light of day after all the storms. Her sweet and gentle voice gently echoed:
"Yeah, it's finally over."
Three years of hiding in hiding, three years of walking side by side, from being an orphan of the royal family living alone in the world, hiding his name, to meeting his companions who stand side by side, from fighting in desperate situations, saving each other again and again, to ending the eternal dark catastrophe with his own hands today.
The forbearance, courage, fatigue and obsession buried deep in my heart, the pain of bloody battles, and the tenacity of rebirth in desperate situations, all turned into stable relief at this moment.
She turned her head to look at Yami Yuya, who was not far away and was out of breath and swaying slightly. Her eyes were filled with deep distress and warmth. She moved lightly and firmly supported the girl's slender arm. Her gentle strength firmly supported her overstretched body.
"Yuya, thank you for your hard work. Throughout the whole battle, you stabilized the illusion and locked the Dark Sakura Queen's consciousness and obsession from beginning to end. You never relaxed even a little bit."
The light and shadow of the second stage of the Purple Violet Samsara Saint Cloth around Yumi Yami's body was faint, and the flowing phantom holy patterns were completely dim. The extremely overdrawn soul gave her a sense of alienation and weakness.
Maintaining a high-level double illusion for several hours, mentally imprisoning the opponent's soul, enduring extreme mental loss and backlash, and superimposing the ultimate burst of the attack, both her body and soul have reached the edge of collapse.
In the past, the cold and aloof eyes, covered with a thin layer of ice, were now slightly watery, with all the alienation, coldness and alertness gone, leaving only the softness and relaxation after extreme exhaustion. The moment her arm was supported by Fujisaki Wakaori's warm fingertips, her extremely tense mind completely relaxed. The tension in her body suddenly dissipated, and she subconsciously leaned slightly towards her close friend beside her.
The cold and hoarse voice, with a trace of hard-to-disguise weariness, sounded softly:
"I just did what I had to do."
The simple and indifferent response hid all her courage and perseverance along the way.
From breaking free from the shackles of darkness, getting rid of the fate of being a puppet, to letting go of the obsession with love and hate in the past, and truly belonging to this team that stands side by side, for her, protecting her companions and this hard-won light has long been an obsession and belief that trumps all.
As long as we can end the darkness and protect the people around us, no matter how much loss or fatigue we suffer, it is all worth it.
Royal God Cang stood quietly at the back of the formation. The two-stage Tingguang Divine Realm Saint Cloth with gradual transition from Tingcang to Glazed Ice was cold and solemn. At this moment, it also absorbed the chilling power of Thunder Judgment and Time Sequence Imprisonment.
The criss-crossing time lines and thunder patterns on the clothes were all dimmed, and the blue-white light flow that froze time and space and shattered illusions was no longer flowing. The twin origins of time and electricity lingering around him had become calmer, but they still maintained the most subtle perception and never completely relaxed their vigilance.
Her dark and clear eyes were still as calm as water, and her cold gaze fell far away in the center of the airspace, on the slender figure suspended in the air, the situation was over, and she was completely defeated.
The whole process was to freeze time and space, seal off the airspace, control the rhythm of the battle, and stabilize the timing of the six-pointed star array. The dual sources were overloaded for a long time, leaving a heavy layer of fatigue on her cold brows and eyes. Her long, soft and hanging blue hair was slightly messy, no longer as neat and quiet as before.
But her tone was still calm and clear, with the most accurate and thorough judgment of the battle situation, and every word was firm and without omissions:
"The original core of Queen Dark Sakura is completely shattered, the Dark Soul is on the verge of collapse, the connection with the global shadow network is permanently broken, and all dark power has been wiped out."
"Now her body is weak, her soul is broken, and her spiritual power has been lost. She has completely become an ordinary person. She has no power to fight anymore, and there is no possibility of mobilizing darkness and causing chaos."
title_en: Chapter 28: Destined decision of life and death. Chapter 27: Bonds are blades and everyone attacks together.
